currentWorkflowHeader:
# PR gate (SC0.6). Runs on every pull request to main. Lint is intentionally
# substituted with `prettier --check` on the MeriV2 code: `pnpm lint` is
# non-functional repo-wide (eslint is not installed), so typecheck + prettier +
# tests are the real quality gate (see docs/plans/2026-06-30-meriv2-DECISIONS.md D3).
name: ci-pr

on:
  pull_request:
    branches: [main]
    types: [opened, synchronize, reopened, ready_for_review]

permissions:
  contents: read

verify: # The full typecheck, package suites, and complete web prerequisite exceeded
# the former 30-minute job budget. Retain every gate.
engagement-phase-2: engagement-phase-2:
# A SEPARATE job, not a step in `verify` above: the existing "Typecheck
# (turbo)" step already fails on main for reasons unrelated to Phase 2
# (four pre-existing rootDir violations in apps/api/src/defense-budget —
# see docs/plans/engagement-api/phase-2-input-lock.md §6). A step appended
# after a failing step in the same job never runs, which would make this
# gate silently never execute while still reporting green-by-omission. A
# sibling job has no such dependency and reports its own real status.
# Uses no AWS credentials, deploys nothing, pushes no image, mutates no
# listener rule, calls no provider, and accesses no production data.
# Every AWS/docker interaction the suite exercises runs against a fake
# binary recorded and asserted on by the tests themselves.
runs-on: ubuntu-latest
env:
NODE_OPTIONS: --max-old-space-size=6144
# verify:engagement-phase-2 re-runs the complete Phase 1 verifier (install,
# Jest, API build, web typecheck and full web suite) before its own gates.
# Phase 1 alone takes ~32 minutes on hosted runners.
timeout-minutes: 75

verify:
python3 scripts/validate-meri-build-isolation.py
python3 scripts/validate-meri-build-isolation.py --self-test
node --test scripts/lib/meri-release-policy.test.mjs scripts/meri-release.test.mjs

pnpm --filter @capiro/api exec prisma generate
pnpm --filter @capiro/workspace exec prisma generate
pnpm --filter @capiro/intel-api exec prisma generate
pnpm --filter @capiro/onboard-api exec prisma generate
pnpm --filter @capiro/api-strategy exec prisma generate

set -euo pipefail
# pull_request.base.sha is not refreshed as main advances.
base="$(git merge-base "origin/${{ github.base_ref }}" HEAD)"
changed_file_list=$(mktemp)
trap 'rm -f "$changed_file_list"' EXIT
git diff --name-only -z --diff-filter=ACMR "$base...HEAD" -- \
  'packages/meriv2-core/**' \
  'apps/meriv2-orchestrator/**' \
  'packages/shared/**' > "$changed_file_list"
mapfile -d '' -t files < "$changed_file_list"
if (( ${#files[@]} == 0 )); then
  echo 'No changed files in the MeriV2/shared formatting scope.'
else
  pnpm exec prettier --check "${files[@]}"
fi

set -e
violations=$(grep -rn "ANTHROPIC_API_KEY" \
  packages/meriv2-core/src \
  apps/meriv2-orchestrator/src \
  --include='*.ts' \
  | grep -v "apps/meriv2-orchestrator/src/meri/meri-registry.service.ts" \
  | grep -v "\.spec\.ts:" \
  || true)
if [ -n "$violations" ]; then
  echo "BYOK violation — direct ANTHROPIC_API_KEY reference outside the resolver:"
  echo "$violations"
  exit 1
fi
echo "BYOK guard passed."

pnpm turbo run build --filter=@capiro/defense-api
pnpm --filter @capiro/defense-api test
engagement-phase-2: pnpm install --frozen-lockfile

pnpm --filter @capiro/shared build
pnpm --filter @capiro/defense-contracts build
pnpm --filter @capiro/defense-domain build
pnpm --filter @capiro/auth build
pnpm --filter @capiro/strategy-verifier build
pnpm --filter @capiro/meriv2-core build
pnpm --filter @capiro/api exec prisma generate
pnpm verify:engagement-phase-2
